# keyfactor_oauth_security_claim (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "keyfactor" {
  username = "COMMAND\\your_username"
  password = "your_api_password"
  hostname = "mykfinstance.kfdelivery.com"
}

data "keyfactor_oauth_security_claim" "existing_claim" {
    claim_type = "OAuthSubject"
    claim_value = "1234567890"
    provider_authentication_scheme = "System"
}

output "existing_claim" {
    value = {
        id = data.keyfactor_oauth_security_claim.existing_claim.id
        claim_type = data.keyfactor_oauth_security_claim.existing_claim.claim_type
        claim_value = data.keyfactor_oauth_security_claim.existing_claim.claim_value
        description = data.keyfactor_oauth_security_claim.existing_claim.description
        provider_authentication_scheme = data.keyfactor_oauth_security_claim.existing_claim.provider_authentication_scheme
        provider = data.keyfactor_oauth_security_claim.existing_claim.provider
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_type` (String) A string containing the claim type of the OAuth security claim in Keyfactor
- `claim_value` (String) A string containing the claim value of the OAuth security claim in Keyfactor
- `provider_authentication_scheme` (String) The identity provider associated with the OAuth security claim. Used only for resource creation. Not returned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A string containing the description of the OAuth security claim in Keyfactor
- `id` (Number) Internal ID of the role.
- `provider` (Object) An object containing the provider of the OAuth security claim in Keyfactor (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provider))

### Nested Schema for `provider`

Read-Only:

- `authentication_scheme` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
